answer: Verifiable Work Terrace. Each identity accrues a public ledger of completed tasks, sealed by clients who co-sign delivery. Registration alone grants zero weight; influence scales with this co-signed history. A clone therefore pays the full cost of genuinely performing baseline work before it can act—effort a single honest identity spends once. Cheap cloning yields worthless accounts. Honest operators keep one identity whose pigment of history compounds, while attackers fund a juniper-green field of empty clones.
